Subject: Request: CascadeEdge entry sweetener (credits + discount) — exec approval

Team,

Quick ask: CascadeEdge (prospect; strong product fit for our observability/embedding use case) has asked for a combined promotional package to commit to a paid pilot. They are motivated to go fast but need a better upfront economics number. I am requesting exec-level approval to offer a one-time promotional package that combines free credits + a first-year discount as an exception. Details below.

Why this matters
- Customer is a strategic reference in fintech (potential >$250k ARR in 18 months if pilot converts).
- They have a competitive evaluation running; engineering is already integrated with a lightweight POC.
- Timeline: pilot kickoff targeted for Jan 10, 2027 — need approved terms to include in the SOW and DocuSign by 12/17.

Proposed package (ask):
- Free credits: $50,000 applied to usage during the pilot (6 weeks)
- Trial extension: pilot extended to 8 weeks (vs standard 4)
- Discount: 20% off list on first-year committed usage if they sign a 12-month commitment within 30 days of pilot close

Supporting materials attached: CascadeEdge_SOW_v2.pdf, CE_usage_forecast_Q1.xlsx, approval_summary_onepager.pdf

Risk & mitigation:
- Revenue impact: estimated gross margin hit ~14% in year 1; expected payback in year 2 given LTV projection in the forecast.
- Abuse: credits tethered to usage by project and expire at contract execution; we will limit to identified account IDs.

Ask:
- Marissa / Markus: short approval or counter-proposal on credit amount / discount by EOD Monday 12/13 so I can finalize SOW and send to the customer for signature.
- Karthik: if approved, please advise on billing flow and how to structure the credit line item on the invoice.

Thanks —
Alex
